{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,

CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)

response: {"thought": "依語意層，淨營收依訂單成立時間（台北時間）歸屬，有效訂單為 status IN (1,2,3)，南部對應 region_code 'TW-S'。先同時計算商品金額（單價欄位與數量相乘兩種）與原訂單退款，確認單位與數量是否需要納入。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["WITH v AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) IN ('2025-04','2025-05','2025-06')) SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS gross_unit_price_sum, (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS gross_qty_x_price, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v)) AS refunds_on_original_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) AS n_valid_orders", "WITH v AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-S' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) IN ('2025-04','2025-05','2025-06')) SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM v) GROUP BY status"]}}
